note: Editorial + public-metric snapshot. Not financial advice.

crypto.name: AIXBT (Virtuals)
crypto.standout: Most-used surface: the public @aixbt_agent feed and terminal, not a nameless swarm child-agent.
bullets: Live narrative, flow, and KOL tracking for large-cap crypto.
Highest mindshare among single-name intel agents.
Best used as a research layer, not an autopilot execution bot.

crypto.name: Coinbase for Agents + Grok
crypto.standout: Most-used client on Coinbase for Agents last measured week: Grok, ahead of Perplexity and Claude.
bullets: Connects a funded Coinbase account to an LLM agent.
Strongest named share of recent agentic trading volume.
Better for execution + portfolio actions than long-form research.

crypto.name: CMC AI
crypto.standout: Most-used surface: CMC AI chat over live CMC market, on-chain, and watchlist data.
bullets: Fast large-cap briefings before a trade.
Reads portfolio/watchlist context if you allow it.
Research only — it does not hold a wallet.

crypto.name: Messari Copilot
crypto.standout: Most-used surface: Copilot answers cited against Messari research and datasets.
bullets: Institutional-style Q&A on sectors and large caps.
Citations make claims easier to check.
Weaker on second-to-second tape than AIXBT or Coinbase Agents.

crypto.name: DefiLlama LlamaAI
crypto.standout: Most-used surface: LlamaAI querying DefiLlama TVL, fees, and yields.
bullets: Best free structural read on large-cap DeFi.
Good for comparing protocols, not price calls.

crypto.name: Fetch.ai / ASI Alliance agents
crypto.standout: Most-used surface: ASI/Fetch agent services for economic tasks, not a single celebrity bot.
bullets: Better infrastructure than a weekly alpha feed.
Heavier setup than AIXBT or CMC AI.

crypto.name: ElizaOS agents
crypto.standout: Most-used surface: community Eliza agents on X and Telegram, not one official analyst.
bullets: You can run your own large-cap analyst character.

crypto.name: Bankr
crypto.standout: Most-used surface: Bankr agent executing and commenting on Base/Uniswap flow.
bullets: More execution risk than a read-only copilot.

crypto.name: Virtuals Protocol agents
crypto.standout: Most-used named agent on the launchpad remains AIXBT; treat Virtuals as the factory.
bullets: Useful for discovering new intel agents.
Platform quality is uneven — score the agent, not the ticker.

crypto.name: Freqtrade + FreqAI
crypto.standout: Most-used surface: self-hosted FreqAI strategy bots on CEX/DEX via CCXT.
bullets: ML module is real; results depend on your strategy.

tradfi.name: TradingAgents
tradfi.standout: Most-used surface: the multi-agent desk (analyst / researcher / trader / risk) in the open repo.
bullets: 100k+ GitHub stars; simulates a trading firm.
Best open stack for equity debate workflows.

tradfi.name: Trade Ideas (HOLLY)
tradfi.standout: Most-used surface: HOLLY AI scanner and OddsMaker alerts.
bullets: Built for day-trade scanning, not long-only research.
Paid product with a free tier.

tradfi.name: ai-hedge-fund
tradfi.standout: Most-used surface: Buffett/Munger-style persona agents debating a name.
bullets: Not connected to a broker by default.

tradfi.name: FinRL / FinRL-Trading
tradfi.standout: Most-used surface: FinRL-Trading live layer on top of the research library.

tradfi.name: Interactive Brokers MCP
tradfi.standout: Most-used surface: IBKR MCP letting an agent read positions and draft orders.
bullets: Human approval before send on the safest setups.

tradfi.name: Horizon.Trade
tradfi.standout: Most-used surface: the agentic terminal from research through ticket.

tradfi.name: TrendSpider
tradfi.standout: Most-used surface: automated technical bots and multi-timeframe scans.

tradfi.name: Numerai
tradfi.standout: Most-used surface: the Numerai tournament models, not a chat agent.

tradfi.name: Robinhood / Webull Agentic Trading
tradfi.standout: Most-used surface: bring-your-own MCP agent into a ring-fenced brokerage account.
bullets: Consumer agentic brokerage is live in 2026.
Guardrails and asset coverage still changing.

tradfi.name: Tickeron / Autopilot AI books
tradfi.standout: Most-used surface: public AI portfolios you can inspect or copy.
bullets: Past book performance is not a forecast.

memes.name: AIXBT
memes.standout: Most-used surface: @aixbt_agent narrative posts; that is the product, not a child token.
bullets: Catches rotation early via CT + flows.
Does not launch coins for you.

memes.name: Pump.fun Mayhem Mode
memes.standout: Most-used surface: Mayhem Mode agents trading eligible new Solana memes in the first 24h.
bullets: Native discovery at the launch venue.

memes.name: MemeToro launch agent
memes.standout: Most-used surface: the proposal agent that turns trend data into a public launch manifest.

memes.name: Truth Terminal lineage
memes.standout: Most-used surface: Truth Terminal-style X agents that seed cultural coins (GOAT lineage).

memes.name: Zerebro
memes.standout: Most-used surface: Zerebro’s own content/mint loop across chains.

memes.name: Clanker
memes.standout: Most-used surface: Clanker launch agent that deploys tokens and takes fees.
bullets: Discovery by watching what it launches.

memes.name: ALPHA AI (launchpad agents)
memes.standout: Most-used surface: X-to-token generation agents on meme launchpads.
bullets: Turns a post into name, art, and token.

memes.name: Ave.ai narrative tools
memes.standout: Most-used surface: Ave narrative/on-chain screens for meme rotation.
bullets: Good second screen next to AIXBT.

memes.name: Cookie.fun mindshare
memes.standout: Most-used surface: Cookie mindshare leaderboard for agents and memes.

memes.name: Griffain
memes.standout: Most-used surface: Griffain natural-language Solana agent for DeFi/meme actions.
bullets: NL to on-chain action on Solana.
